title: All the Elders Gathered
text: So all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah.

title: Like All the Other Nations
text: Now appoint a king to judge us like all the other nations.

title: Displeasing to Samuel
text: But when they said, “Give us a king to judge us,” their demand was displeasing in the sight of Samuel; so he prayed to the LORD.

title: They Have Rejected Me
text: For it is not you they have rejected, but they have rejected Me as their king.

title: The Manner of the King
text: This will be the manner of the king who will reign over you …

title: You Will Beg for Relief
text: When that day comes, you will beg for relief from the king you have chosen, but the LORD will not answer you on that day.

title: We Must Have a King
text: No! | We must have a king over us.

title: Appoint a King for Them
text: “Listen to their voice,” the LORD said to Samuel. “Appoint a king for them.”

title: Kish of Benjamin
text: Now there was a Benjamite, a powerful man, whose name was Kish …

title: A Head Taller
text: And he had a son named Saul, choice and handsome, without equal among the Israelites—a head taller than any of the people.

title: The Donkeys Wandered Off
text: One day the donkeys of Saul’s father Kish wandered off …

title: The Hill Country of Ephraim
text: So Saul passed through the hill country of Ephraim and then through the land of Shalishah, but they did not find the donkeys.

title: The Land of Shalishah
text: So Saul passed through the hill country of Ephraim and then through the land of Shalishah …

title: The Land of Benjamin
text: Then they went through the land of Benjamin, and still they did not find them.

title: They Did Not Find Them
text: … but they did not find the donkeys.

title: Start Worrying about Us
text: Come, let us go back, or my father will stop worrying about the donkeys and start worrying about us.

title: A Man of God
text: Look, | in this city there is a man of God who is highly respected; everything he says surely comes to pass.

title: Is the Seer Here?
text: … they met some young women coming out to draw water and asked, “Is the seer here?”

title: He Is Ahead of You
text: Yes, he is ahead of you …

title: A Sacrifice on the High Place
text: Hurry now, for today he has come to the city because the people have a sacrifice on the high place.

title: He Must Bless the Sacrifice
text: The people will not eat until he comes, because he must bless the sacrifice …

title: The Day Before Saul’s Arrival
text: Now on the day before Saul’s arrival, the LORD had revealed to Samuel …

title: Anoint Him Ruler
text: At this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin, and you are to anoint him ruler over My people Israel …

title: Their Cry Has Come to Me
text: For I have looked upon My people, because their cry has come to Me.

title: Here Is the Man
text: Here is the man of whom I spoke; he shall rule over My people.

title: I Am the Seer
text: I am the seer, …

title: They Have Been Found
text: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them, for they have been found.

title: All the Desire of Israel
text: And upon whom is all the desire of Israel, if not upon you and all your father’s house?

title: The Smallest Tribe
text: Am I not a Benjamite from the smallest tribe of Israel, and is not my clan the least of all the clans of Benjamin?

title: Stay for a While
text: … but you stay for a while, and I will reveal to you the word of God.

title: A Flask of Oil
text: Then Samuel took a flask of oil, poured it on Saul’s head, kissed him …

title: Anointed Ruler
text: Has not the LORD anointed you ruler over His inheritance?

title: A Different Person
text: … and you will be transformed into a different person.

title: For God Is with You
text: When these signs have come, do as the occasion demands, for God is with you.

title: Summoned to Mizpah
text: After this, Samuel summoned the people to the LORD at Mizpah …

title: I Rescued You
text: … and I rescued you from the hands of the Egyptians and of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.

title: You Have Rejected Your God
text: But today you have rejected your God, who saves you from all your troubles and afflictions …

title: The Tribe of Benjamin
text: Thus Samuel had all the tribes of Israel come forward, and the tribe of Benjamin was selected.

title: The Clan of Matri
text: Then he had the tribe of Benjamin come forward by its clans, and the clan of Matri was selected.

title: Saul Son of Kish
text: Finally, Saul son of Kish was selected.

title: They Could Not Find Him
text: But when they looked for him, they could not find him.

title: Hidden among the Baggage
text: Behold, | he has hidden himself among the baggage.

title: They Brought Saul
text: So they ran and brought Saul, and when he stood among the people, he was a head taller than any of the others.

title: The One the LORD Has Chosen
text: Do you see the one the LORD has chosen? There is no one like him among all the people.

title: Long Live the King
text: And all the people shouted, “Long live the king!”

title: My Kingdom Is Not of This World
text: My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews.

title: Like the Other Nations
text: Now appoint a king to judge us like all the other nations.

title: Your Sons Do Not Walk in Your Ways
text: Look, | you are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways.

title: Saul’s Father
text: One day the donkeys of Saul’s father Kish wandered off …

title: Found
text: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them, for they have been found.

title: All the Tribes
text: Thus Samuel had all the tribes of Israel come forward, and the tribe of Benjamin was selected.
